summary: Vaxcyte, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an offering of $500 million aggregate principal amount of 1.50% convertible senior notes due 2032, with an option for underwriters to purchase up to an additional $75 million for over-allotments. Interest is payable semi-annually starting April 15, 2027. The initial conversion price is approximately $89.60 per share, subject to adjustment. The notes are redeemable under certain conditions and noteholders may require repurchase upon a fundamental change. This is a routine convertible debt offering, not a special situation.
